beetalents-bee-talents:lever:b6cd780d-ed.description: Kim jesteśmy? Cześć, nazywamy się Bee Talents i od 2015 roku zajmujemy się budowaniem zespołów w różnych branżach na całym świecie. Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla klienta Reforma Nieruchomości. Reforma Nieruchomości to firma, która od 12 lat sprzedaje mieszkania w zreformowanych przez siebie kamienicach i konsekwentnie się rozwija, odnosząc kolejne sukcesy na rynku poznańskim. Aktywnie uczestniczy w kształtowaniu wizerunku miasta, pracując z jego historycznymi budynkami. Od początku swojej działalności podejmuje odważne decyzje, sięgając po projekty wymagające odpowiedzialności i wywierające długofalowy wpływ na lokalną branżę nieruchomości. Organizację wyróżnia uważność na kontekst miejsca, rzetelność realizacji oraz profesjonalizm w działaniu. Projekty Reformy Nieruchomości koncentrują się na zachowaniu i utrwaleniu wartości zabytkowej obiektów. Działania firmy zostały docenione nagrodą przyznaną przez Narodowy Instytut Dziedzictwa. Obecnie Reformę Nieruchomości tworzy 25-osobowy zespół, który kieruje się jasno określonymi wartościami. Firma dba o unikatowe nieruchomości, szanuje ich historię i przywraca im drugie życie, wprowadzając jednocześnie rozwiązania ekologiczne. Ich dewiza to ,,jedyną stałą rzeczą jest zmiana”. To środowisko, które daje przestrzeń do kreowania rzeczywistości, ale wymaga elastyczności, szybkiego reagowania na nowe okoliczności oraz świadomej analizy celu i realizacji założeń. Dziś zapraszamy do współpracy doświadczoną osobę na rolę Project Managera/ki, która będzie odpowiedzialnie i z zaangażowaniem tworzyć i zarządzać procesem i remontem. Warunki współpracy: 🎯Oferowane stanowisko: Project Manager/ka 💰Wynagrodzenie: 14-20k PLN/mies., tj. 95-135 PLN/h netto na B2B (możliwy UoP) ⏱ Wymiar pracy: 168h 👩‍💻Tryb pracy: stacjonarna (w biurze lub “na budowie”) 📍Lokalizacja biura: Poznań, ul. Kraszewskiego 17/12 🇵🇱Język pracy: polski

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:ed.description: Come join our team at Optimal! We know a few things about competing with giants and exceeding expectations. After years of working in the field, our founders decided to break from tradition and build the company they wanted to work for. They believed in starting a company rooted in trust, its team, and the idea that everyone matters and has a part in getting the job done right. Quickly building a reputation from the ground up and growing the company along with our list of clients, Optimal is now influencing the industry and the people we serve. We live by the values that make us who we are. And that is how we deliver the impossible for our clients and team members every day. Optimal Field Services, based out of Geismar, La., is a provider of turnkey industrial services to the petroleum, petrochemical, specialty chemical, gas processing and paper processing industries. We are currently accepting applications for experienced Boilermakers to join our team. Boilermakers must have a minimum of 3 years experience in a petrochemical, pulp and paper, or related industrial facility, and have the ability to read and interpret blueprints, ISO's, field drawings, and material takeoffs. Boilermakers will perform a wide range of duties which may include but are not limited to rigging, bolt torquing, constructing, assembling, maintaining, modifying, removal, replacement, and repairing of the internal and external parts of boilers, heaters, and coded pressure vessels such as towers, reactors and drums. NCCER certification is desired.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:faaa2bfe-ba5.title: Field Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:faaa2bfe-ba5.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:77252878-3020-.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:77252878-3020-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer based in Ireland. This is a senior engineering opportunity within a fast-growing consumer AI platform serving students across multiple international markets. You will play a key role in building and evolving products used by a rapidly expanding global user base. The position combines full-stack development with technical leadership and ownership of mobile experiences. You will work across modern web and mobile technologies, collaborating closely with engineering and product leadership. As the first dedicated senior/staff-level mobile lead, you will have significant influence over the architecture, quality, and direction of the mobile application. The environment is remote-first, collaborative, and highly autonomous, with a small engineering team where individual contributions have visible impact. This role is ideal for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys hands-on development, technical ownership, and mentoring other engineers. Take senior-level ownership of full-stack product development across web and mobile applications. Lead the technical direction and end-to-end development of the mobile application, working closely with engineering and product leadership. Contribute to the development and evolution of React Native applications, including architecture, performance, reliability, and user experience. Design, build, and maintain scalable frontend and backend systems using TypeScript and the broader technology stack. Develop modern web experiences using React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind. Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js, Nest.js, Prisma, and AWS. Collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to translate product requirements into robust, maintainable technical solutions. Establish and maintain high engineering standards, including code quality, testing, documentation, version control, and collaborative development practices. Contribute to technical architecture decisions and continuously improve application performance, scalability, and reliability. Support automated and end-to-end testing practices, including Playwright where appropriate. Mentor, guide, and support other engineers while helping raise the team's technical capabilities. Lead and manage engineering initiatives, balancing hands-on development with technical leadership and team coordination. Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, engineering processes, and the overall product development lifecycle. Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer. Strong proficiency in TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Hands-on experience with Node.js, React.js, Next.js, Nest.js, Prisma, and Tailwind. Experience developing and maintaining modern web applications and backend services. Experience with React Native and mobile application development, with the ability to take ownership of mobile architecture and delivery. Strong understanding of Git and collaborative software development workflows. Experience leading or managing engineering teams, projects, or technical initiatives. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean architecture, maintainable code, debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Ability to work effectively across the frontend, backend, and mobile layers of a product. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with product and engineering leadership. High degree of ownership, autonomy, and accountability in a remote working environment. Experience writing end-to-end tests with Playwright is a plus. Experience with Python is a plus. Familiarity with Jotai, Zustand, Redux, or similar state-management solutions is a plus. Experience with Expo and AWS is advantageous. Benefits Fully remote opportunity within Europe, with a preference for candidates based in West

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f6f39330-5fd7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Operations, Data Science based in Poland. This is a senior, cross-functional role connecting business strategy, data science, technology, and client delivery. You will help turn complex data and analytical capabilities into practical solutions that improve business performance. The role combines operational leadership with product-oriented thinking and hands-on Agile development management. You will coordinate high-impact data science workstreams across strategy, growth, finance, technology, and other teams. You will also support client engagements, workshops, and business development opportunities by translating technical insights into clear business value. Agile delivery management: Experience managing Agile development processes, including epic planning, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and delivery coordination. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fc3852de-0cf7-.title: Team Lead Product Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:fc3852de-0cf7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in South Africa. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. Strong ownership mindset, independence, and the ability to take analytical projects from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement. Genuine interes

With a collaborative and inclusive environment, you will join a unique culture which celebrates difference and embraces diversity.
